note.en: Semi-analytic reference vth=omega_p=lambda_D=1,k.5,L4pi,alpha.01,grid32,256spatial strata×128velocity nodes,dt.04,T16,fit[4,12],seeds33001–33004. A separately evolved512-spatial-strata companion changes only particle-space resolution. Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established.
